title: PERISTIWA TIGA DAERAH (ANTON E. LUCAS)
comment:
This is an Indonesian translation of the publication "One Soul One Struggle: Region and revolution in Indonesia". It is a study of the Indonesian revolution at the grass-roots level. Focus on the Three Regions Affair (Indonesia) (Tiga Daerah) in Pekalongan in northern Central Java in 1945. More than 350 participants in the Three Regions Affair (Indonesia) were interviewed by the author. Published in association with Resist Books in 1991. A second edition was published in 2004. A third edition was published by Media Pressindo in 2019.
Source: Anton Lucas Collection (Flinders University Library)
